# /vg/ League 26

Squad of 23. A player's rating is his best of: dribbling, goalkeeping, low pass, lofted pass, swerve, catching, clearing, reflexes, coverage, body control, physical contact, kicking power, explosive power, ball control, ball winning, jump, place kicking, stamina, speed.
May sit below their target: attacking prowess, defensive prowess, weak foot usage, weak foot accuracy.

## Tiers
- **Gold**: 1 per team, 195 cm; every stat 99 (place kicking 94, defensive prowess 60, ball winning 94); form 8, injury resistance 2, weak foot 4/4; 9 paid cards, 2 free COM styles, 12 free tricks; 2 A positions.
- **Silver**: 2 per team, 195 cm; every stat 95 (attacking prowess 99, finishing 99, place kicking 90, heading 99, defensive prowess 60, ball winning 90); form 8, injury resistance 2, weak foot 4/4; 8 paid cards, 2 free COM styles, 12 free tricks; 2 A positions.
- **Bronze**: 2 per team, 190 cm; every stat 91 (attacking prowess 96, finishing 96, place kicking 86, heading 96, defensive prowess 60, ball winning 86); form 8, injury resistance 2, weak foot 4/4; 8 paid cards, 2 free COM styles, 12 free tricks; 2 A positions.
- **Buffed**: 8 per team, 185 cm, except registered GK; every stat 85 (attacking prowess 90, defensive prowess 60, ball winning 65, jump 75, stamina 70, aggression 90); form 4, injury resistance 1, weak foot 4/4; 7 paid cards, 1 free COM style, 12 free tricks; 2 A positions.
- **Goalkeeper**: counts as Regular, registered GK; every stat 72; form 8, injury resistance 1, weak foot 4/4; 5 paid cards, 1 free COM style, 12 free tricks; 1 A position.
- **Regular**: 10 per team, 180 cm; every stat 80 (defensive prowess 70, ball winning 70, explosive power 70, jump 80, goalkeeping 72, catching 72, clearing 72, reflexes 72, coverage 72, stamina 65, aggression 90); form 4, injury resistance 1, weak foot 4/4; 6 paid cards, 1 free COM style, 12 free tricks; 2 A positions.

## Every team
Every player is rated A at his registered position; starters play only where rated A in preset 1; no B ratings; GK is never a second A; age 15 to 50; weight between height − 129 (at least 30) and height − 81; a captain; at least 1 goalkeeper; at most 41 skill cards.

## Card groups
- **Tricks**: scissors feint, double touch, flip flap, marseille turn, sombrero, crossover turn, cut behind and turn, scotch move, step on skill, rabona, no look pass, malicia.

## Team settings
- **No man marking**: man marking off.
- **Support settings**: automatic substitution off, automatic offside trap off, automatic preset change off.
- **No 3-4-3 formations**: no 3-4-3 formations.

## Special rules
- **Heading is a free card**: Heading free.
- **The captain's Captaincy card and one more are free**: The captain: +1 paid card, Captaincy free.
- **Medals cannot be goalkeepers**: Gold, Silver or Bronze, registered GK: not allowed ("Medals cannot play as GK").
- **Goalkeepers are 185**: Registered GK, except 185 cm: not allowed ("GKs must be 185cm").
